items.title: Make Developer obstacle removal visible and simulation-timed
executionLog: S178: Developer wall removal now advances for 240 simulation frames, restores on gameplay steps, and invalidates painted arena layers and flow fields at both transitions. Focused pause/recast tests and eight visual-harness captures passed.
items.why: The Developer boss removes collision with setTimeout, so pause does not pause its four-second effect. Arena obstacles are painted into a cache keyed by count and epoch, neither of which changes when width and height are set to zero. Core-loop step: input and danger readability.
items.recipe: Track an obstacle's saved geometry and remaining duration in simulation frames; restore during enemy frames; invalidate arena layers and flow fields at both transitions; prove pause immunity, visible cache invalidation, and repeated casts in a focused boss test.

items.title: Make ordinary perk numbers and shot cadence agree
executionLog: S178: All 27 ordinary perks share numeric facts with runtime behavior and copy. Overclocked and Overdrive now deliver the stated +35% and +40% shot cadence; Dead Man's Hand/Last Resort triples actual blast damage. Perk and death-flow behavior tests plus desktop/mobile visual captures passed.
items.why: Ordinary perk descriptions and apply functions duplicate numeric values. Overclocked claims +35% fire rate while a 0.65 interval gives about +54% shot cadence; Overdrive claims +40% while 0.60 gives about +67%. Core-loop step: perk reward and build progression.
